verdict.rationale: Sandbox0's coding-agents use-case docs describe a template that ships Google Chrome Stable, Playwright CLI, a sandbox0-browser component, TigerVNC, the Openbox window manager and a built-in noVNC viewer. That covers both a headless/automated browser and a viewable desktop environment inside the sandbox. Custom images and installing software inside the sandbox further support this. Missing for 10: in-depth dedicated docs on browser/desktop setup and resource requirements, independent or hands-on corroboration that the browser and VNC desktop work as described.
